title: Concept: Dynamic evaluation via x.html_safe (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, x.html_safe resolves, renders or loads at runtime, so a value that reaches it selects the code path or markup that is produced. The remedy is an explicit branch over known operations with escaping (escaped output).
